title: Two Countries One Heart — EN/SN/ZU (Mbira Folk)
style: Zimbabwean mbira folk urban grooves acoustic guitar hosho shakers ngoma drums warm baritone 82bpm analog tape warm storytelling Shona Zulu heritage identity diaspora
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
I carry two countries inside my chest
Australia gave me shelter, Zimbabwe gave me rest
One built my bones the other built my soul
Two countries meeting in me make me whole

[Verse 2 — Shona, with English translation]
Nyika mbiri dziri mumwoyo wangu
[Two countries are in my heart]
Zimbabwe yandirera kubva ndichiri mudiki
[Zimbabwe raised me from when I was small]
Australia yakamusha wangu kuva musha wake
[Australia made my home its own]
Ndiri mwana wenyika mbiri, nguva dzose
[I am a child of two countries, always]

[Chorus — English]
Two countries, one heart
One love that holds together what is apart
Two countries, one song
The melody of who I am, where I belong

[Bridge — Zulu, with English translation]
Nginemazwe amabili enhliziyweni yami
[I have two countries in my heart]
IZimbabwe ingikhulisile, iAustralia ingamukele
[Zimbabwe raised me, Australia welcomed me]
Ngiyingane yamazwe amabili, ngigcwele
[I am a child of two countries, I am complete]
Umlando wami uhlanganisa izwekazi ezimbili
[My story connects two continents]

[Outro — All three languages]
Two countries, one heart… Nyika mbiri, mwoyo umwe… Amazwe amabili, inhliziyo eyodwa
Belonging everywhere — Kuva wenyika yose — Ukhona yonke indawo
The gardens still growing
